flying-chests.texture_config.chestUseRes: When enabled, uses vanilla minecraft chest texture paths so resource packs that change chest textures will also affect the flying chest. When disabled, bundled texture copies are used and are unaffected by resource packs.
flying-chests.texture_config.chestVarian: Which chest texture style to use for the flying chest.
flying-chests.texture_config.baseUseReso: When enabled, uses vanilla minecraft chest texture paths so resource packs that change chest textures will also affect the base station. When disabled, bundled texture copies are used and are unaffected by resource packs.
flying-chests.texture_config.baseVariant: Which chest texture style to use for the base station.
flying-chests.texture_config.wingsUseRes: When enabled, uses vanilla minecraft entity texture paths so resource packs that change bee, allay, or bat textures will also affect the wings. When disabled, bundled texture copies are used and are unaffected by resource packs.
flying-chests.texture_config.wingsVarian: Which wing model and texture to use.
flying-chests.texture_config.flapSpeed.d: Multiplier for wing flap animation speed across all wing types. Default is 1.0.
